classification_legend.implemented_supported: Implemented and supported by the cited test/evidence, only to its stated scope
classification_legend.implemented_insufficiently_tested: Implemented path or partial safeguard; direct combination/domain coverage insufficient
classification_legend.documented_assumption: Documented approximation/assumption without a demonstrated runtime enforcement envelope
classification_legend.not_applicable_synthetic_scope: Not applicable to present synthetic execution; future hardware obligation remains

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Speed [1,3] and corridor; invalid exhaustion breaks before baseline invocation.
safeguards.coverage_limit: C70 retained high-speed stop supports async invalid branch; MPC rejection tests cover separate synchronous finalize path, not all async boundary cases.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Finite vectors, speed floor/ceiling, input limits, loads, Frenet denominator, longitudinal grip; RK4 stages/final checked.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Does not certify continuous trajectory, corridor invariance, beta limits or physical model fidelity.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Baseline rate/angle and acceleration clipping; tracker box; actual elapsed-application steering clamp.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Not actuator dynamics; coupled tire feasibility still checked by plant. Delayed fallback integral/gain transient combinations incompletely tested.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: DARE at 1,2,3 and interpolation; clamp scheduling variable only.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Frozen linear pole tests do not prove nonlinear recovery or arbitrary time-varying stability.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Finite curvature/positive speed checked; no small-error, slip or curvature-magnitude admission envelope.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Baseline integration evidence uses linear tires on circle/oval; not all racing combined-grip fallback states.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Finite inputs and nominal dt; conditional integral, command clipping; default target 2 m/s.
safeguards.coverage_limit: No stop-to-zero policy; busy intervals do not update integral and elapsed time is not substituted.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Generation guarded; due applications precede domain checks; held-pair plant validity checked before propagation.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Named test covers synchronous MPC, not asynchronous fallback. No invariant [1,3]/corridor guarantee between ticks or at delayed application; no new counterfactual executed.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Immutable finite arrays, ordered times/progress; buffer refuses expired authority, direct packet endpoint allowed only for evaluation.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Buffer trusts valid flag and producer contract; does not itself re-solve nonlinear feasibility.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Newer packet, available time, >=50 ms reserve plus wrapped six-state mismatch and nominal plant validation.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Envelope is synthetic; not invariant-tube or safety proof.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Thresholds classified/logged; active critical trajectory remains usable until exhaustion.
safeguards.coverage_limit: No reserve-triggered urgent solve, braking, deadline guarantee or adaptive reserve policy.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Invalid solver output is rejected, failed prediction/gains yield no packet; old accepted plan remains.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Preserves prior authority only while it has reserve; no guaranteed replacement.

safeguards.safeguard: One pending solve and urgent latch
safeguards.implemented_behavior: Busy misses logged; physics/codriver continue; one error-trigger latch, nominal priority; fixed-mode grid rule.
safeguards.coverage_limit: No cancellation/parallel rescue; persistent error does not repeatedly retrigger without clearing.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Application before handoff; request source plan ID and mode retained across new authority.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Direct old-command-to-fallback plus nonzero latency coverage is missing; preservation is not a new sample of expired authority.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: No reentry; late completion rejected as fallback_latched; nominal/urgent planning disabled.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Dedicated fallback-exit/domain-edge/zero-latency and early-waiting combinations not comprehensively asserted.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Miss at deadline does not cancel busy work; late packet discarded, never active.
safeguards.coverage_limit: VIS measured 478-484 discard observed; 485 completion censored. A has no fixed-deadline count.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Runtime trajectory-mode boundary flag and offline campaign gate only; fallback generation checks center corridor.
safeguards.coverage_limit: No continuous collision prevention, footprint model, invariant tube or within-run boundary emergency stop.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Invalid domain breaks loop or catches model error; no brake command or zero-speed dynamics.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Synthetic stop is failure evidence, not a hardware fail-safe.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: mode identifies fallback; controls retain last packet ID and zero-error/current-state placeholders; campaign flags any fallback.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Do not score placeholders as APEX tracking. Direct packet endpoint may be sampled offline despite zero buffer reserve; not executable authority. No generic successful-fallback export coverage claimed.

safeguards.safeguard: State estimation, uncertainty and hardware execution
safeguards.implemented_behavior: Perfect state supplied by synthetic plant; no hardware command transport.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Mandatory separate work before hardware; this classification does not excuse missing hardware safety.

safeguards.implemented_behavior: Raw capture precedes export; known nested NumPy boolean error preserves physical evidence but loses final package/summary.
safeguards.coverage_limit: Inherited known defect; expected exception is not an export-success test; no fix authorized.

inherited_test_provenance.applicability: Exact selected tests, src/configs/dependencies and retained fixture hashes unchanged since CX; same recorded numerical versions. Does not constitute formal verification of newer VIS tools.
inherited_test_provenance.VIS_report_test: Existing d55f203 report test with preserved passing recheck; separate from CX 284 subset.

new_checks: Source and transitive configuration/fixture hash identity
Four retained physical histories and C70 exhaustion/absence-of-fallback-mode reconciliation
Documentation links/line ranges/JSON consistency/preservation/git diff checks
mandatory_future_tests: Async ineligible entry/continuation at all speed/corridor edges, invalid finite-state/curvature and model exceptions
Delayed fallback domain exit and held-command validity, old requests across expiry/handoff/fallback, exact simultaneous events
Repeated preparation/predictor/gain failures, mismatch/stale/reserve rejection and pending/waiting combinations without expiry extrapolation
Fallback nonlinear recovery envelope using approved identified physics and uncertainty, PI busy-tick behavior, no misleading tracking-success metrics
Hardware watchdog/stop-to-rest/communication and timing faults after separate design authorization
remaining_gate: Engineering Review, then separately authorized E2 manifest and E3 formal verification; no freeze implied
